To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a neural network based system, which can identify women at high risk for developing breast cancer from healthy women on the basis of their risk factors.

a) the model can be successfully used for the identification of women at increased risk of breast cancer, b) the model is able to select the most important risk factors and to reduce their number, c) the model is robust to the changes of the input data set, d) the model is capable of identifying the most important features, e) the model is applicable for the identification of high risk women in a large scale.

(a) a neural network model can be used for an efficient automated identification of high-risk women from a wide healthy population, and (b) a properly selected set features can lead to an accurate classification of women into two groups: high and low risk of developing breast cancers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the identification of a small set of risk factors, which are highly correlated with the occurrence of breast cancer.
the development of a new method for early detection of breast cancers.
a new approach to breast cancer risk assessment.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the presented neural network based model is a promising approach for the early breast cancer detection, which can help the physicians to identify women at high risk and thus can contribute to the efficient breast cancer prevention.
the proposed model can be successfully used in the early detection of breast cancers and in the selection of patients who are at high risk of the disease.
our neural network model can be used for the early detection of breast cancers with a high level of accuracy.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have successfully identified a small set of risk factors that can be used for an accurate early detection of breast cancers.
a neural network based approach to the problem of breast cancer detection is efficient, and it can be used as an early screening tool.
a neural network based classification model can provide a reliable and accurate tool for the early detection of breast cancers.

the neural network approach to the problem of breast cancer risk identification is very efficient and accurate and it can be applied for early detection and prevention of the breast cancer.
the proposed neural network model is able to efficiently classify healthy and unhealthy women on the basis of a small number of risk factors, which can be easily obtained.
the neural network model can provide a highly accurate classification of women at risk of breast cancer.
